title: GET/PUT /api/settings/profiles
description: House settings of the profile model: default profile per device type and the default guest duration. The default profile applies wherever nobody picks a profile: preselection when pairing, onboarding by a member, guest invitations by a member (always the guest default profile and duration), pairing through the integration, API calls without profile. A default profile cannot be deleted. guest: never a profile with parental controls (422).

guest_default_hours.description: Default duration of a guest access (preset of the invitation; guest_access.max_hours is the maximum).
